sources.observation: Section 180.50(b)(2)(i)(A) requires the location name and address(es) for the location(s) to which the standard-charge list applies. Section 180.50(d)(2) requires the information to be clearly identified with the hospital location with which it is associated. Section 180.50(d)(6)(i) describes the root text file's location name corresponding to the MRF and direct MRF URL.
